summary: The National Congress of American Indians transmits Resolution MEM-26-016 to Chairman Swett, asking FERC to impose a moratorium on approvals supporting hyperscale data centers until independent grid and ratepayer assessments are done, with cost protections and Tribal consultation.
ask: Impose an immediate moratorium on certificates, transmission approvals and authorizations for hyperscale data centers pending an independent assessment, with binding cost allocation conditions and mandatory Tribal consultation.

points.point: NCAI asks for a moratorium on related approvals until an independent impact assessment is completed.
points.quote: impose an immediate moratorium on the issuance of any related certificates, transmission approvals, or regulatory authorizations supporting hyperscale data centers

points.point: It wants binding conditions so data center upgrade costs fall on facility operators, not existing Tribal or residential ratepayers.
points.quote: all grid and infrastructure upgrade costs attributable to data center demand are borne entirely by the facility operators, not passed on to existing Tribal or residential ratepayers.

points.point: It asks for independent, conflict-free assessments of resource adequacy and congestion effects.
points.quote: rigorous, independent, and conflict-free assessments of how these facilities impact regional resource adequacy and transmission congestion

points.point: It asks for Tribal consultation at the outset of transmission planning or interconnection for these developments.
points.quote: engage Tribal Nations as sovereign partners at the outset of any transmission planning or interconnection process

throughLine.text: Letter filed in EL26-67 after the show cause order; its call for data center operators to bear upgrade costs echoes the cost-shifting concern in the E-7 cost recovery directive but answers no directive.
